summary: GCL Global Holdings Ltd., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on July 31, 2026, furnishing a press release and investor deck announcing its fiscal year 2026 financial results. The release outlines revenues of $238.9 million (up 68.2%), a net loss of $26.2 million, and an EBITDA loss of $18.9 million. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or strategic review is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings announcement and conference call notice, not a special-situation transaction. The registrant is the issuer reporting its operational results.
